msrp.title: New Cars Selling Below MSRP (November 2026): 21 Ranked | Steer Me Right
msrp.description: Which new cars sell furthest under sticker this month: 21 models ranked by how far under MSRP a fair deal runs, with dollars off, this month’s manufacturer offer and the trims that hold at sticker.
lead: Pickups leave the most room this month. A fair deal on the {top1} {top1Trim} is {top1Fair} under sticker, about {top1Dollars} on a {top1Price} truck, and {deepestRest} all start at 5% under or better. The {bottom1}, {bottom2} and {bottom3} leave the least: {bottomRange} under at a fair price, and the RAV4’s dearest trims sell at sticker.
Below, all 21 models we cover sit at the trim we’d buy, each with the dollars off and a line on why the number is what it is.

tesla.heading: Tesla: a set price new, 1% to 4% under asking used
tesla.intro: Tesla sells new cars direct at a posted price, so there is no dealer discount to chase on a new Model Y or Model 3. On used ones, the rows below are our estimate off the dealer’s asking price.

method: Cars are placed by the middle of the fair-deal range in each price guide, for the pay row that covers the trim we’d buy. Ties go to the strong-deal range. Dollars are that percentage of the trim’s starting MSRP as the guide lists it, rounded to $50.

Fair and strong deals are our estimates from the sources each guide names: TrueCar’s market averages, Edmunds’ Texas suggested prices, Kelley Blue Book’s fair purchase prices, iSeeCars invoice figures, CarWhere’s verified buyers and owner reports. The headline offer is the one in each guide’s offers tile, read on the date shown there; the deals page has every offer with its end date.
faq: Which new cars have the biggest discounts right now?
{top3Names} lead the 21 models we cover. A fair deal on each starts at {top3Floor} under sticker or better, because the makers carry more trucks than the industry average.
Is a car selling below MSRP the price I will pay?
No. A dealer discount, manufacturer cash, destination, add-ons and fees are separate lines on the quote. Compare them on one written out-the-door price, as in buying a new car below MSRP.
Do manufacturer offers come on top of these discounts?
Mostly, though a maker’s low rate often replaces its cash, so you pick one. The deals page lists each offer with its end date and works out cash against 0%.

faq: Can I get 0% APR and cash back together?

Seldom. On the F-150, Silverado, Sierra, CX-5, Ram and Tundra the cash and the low rate are separate offers. A small bonus sometimes rides with the rate, such as Ford’s $500 with its 0%, but the headline cash does not.
Does every buyer get these rates?
No. The rates and leases need approval through the maker’s own lender, and most are for well-qualified buyers. The guides say which offers need which lender.
Is the dealer’s discount on top of the manufacturer’s offer?
The price guides treat them as separate lines, and the list of cars selling below MSRP covers the dealer side. Ask for both on one written quote so you can see the price after each.
